name: agent_turns
description: One user message and its execution lifecycle, real progress, and versioned assistant outcome. Failed/interrupted turns retain no fabricated answer.
lifecycle: Local history persists until the owner explicitly deletes the conversation. Conversation deletion cascades to turns and contexts. No automatic expiry is implemented; shared deployment requires an owner-defined retention/backups/provider policy before rollout. No vector, export or replica copies are created by the application.

columns.Meaning: Owning conversation; hard deletion cascades to all turns.
Client UUID for idempotent acceptance replay; same id with different message is a conflict.
running, completed, failed or interrupted. Interrupted work is not automatically retried.
Bounded confidential user message; never logged.
Version 1 envelope containing application-authored reply and bounded result snapshot. Not current ERP truth and never sent back to OpenAI as financial data.
columns.Null meaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

columns.Meaning: Bounded ordered real progress events with stage, localized display message and instant; not durable workflow/audit infrastructure.
Executed capability for a completed business reply; absent for social/failure turns.
columns.Null meaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

columns.Meaning: Allowlisted public failure code; absent unless failed/interrupted. No exception text.
columns.Null meaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

columns.Meaning: Database-clock terminal outcome instant; absent while running.
columns.Null meaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES agent_conversations(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: Conversation ownership/lifecycle referential integrity; cascade on hard deletion.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((((state)::text = 'running'::text) AND (reply IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL) AND (finished_at IS NULL)) OR (((state)::text = 'completed'::text) AND (reply IS NOT NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['failed'::character varying, 'interrupted'::character varying])::text[])) AND (reply IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Terminal reply/failure and timestamp agree with lifecycle state.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['running'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'interrupted'::character varying])::text[])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_turns_conversation_request_key ON public.agent_turns USING btree (conversation_id, request_id)
constraints.Purpose: One acceptance per client request id in a conversation.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_turns_conversation_sequence_key ON public.agent_turns USING btree (conversation_id, sequence)
